heur_ev.label: rank-and-fill with recourse, settings tuned by E[NPV]

heur_ce.label: rank-and-fill with recourse, settings tuned by CE (oracle)

rn.label: risk-neutral two-stage MIP at the strip (plan reused: it does not depend on rho)

rn_tilt1.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP, one fixed-point iteration from rn (time includes rn)

rn_tilt2.label: pi-tilted risk-neutral MIP, two fixed-point iterations from rn (time includes rn, rn_tilt1)

rn_deck.label: risk-neutral MIP at the oracle-selected planning deck (grid 0.7-1.05 by 0.05; best 0.95); time includes rn

ce.label: certified CE solver seeded with rn, heur_ce, rn_tilt2 (time includes the seeds)

heur_ev+rn_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ev, risk-neutral recourse

heur_ev+exact_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ev, certified CE recourse

heur_ce+exact_recourse.label: first stage of heur_ce, certified CE recourse

rn+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn, certified CE recourse

rn_deck+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn_deck, certified CE recourse

rn_tilt2+exact_recourse.label: first stage of rn_tilt2, certified CE recourse

mv_rn.label: mean-value first stage (theta = P = 1, risk-neutral) with risk-neutral recourse on the tree

plan_format.encoding: z0/zk: positions in idx0/idx1; y: packages; w0: units; wk: per node, u * (T - 1) + (t - 1)
